entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Vivek Chandra, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Shri Shaunak Singh, the learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
818 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 12.08.2022 against four named persons, including the applicant, alleging that the informant had made some investments in Lifelong Multi State Cooperative Society and Sangarsh Total Solution Infra Built Pvt. Ltd. but upon maturity neither his amount was repaid nor the sale deed was executed in his favour.

entities.text: Sangarsh Total Solution Infra Built Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant has been implicated in the present case subsequently, as he is also a Director of the body in which the investment was made.

Sharad Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy.Home on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6878557/
1 4.

entities.text: Sharad Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy.Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant's involvement in total 43 cases of similar nature has been disclosed in para 17 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, in 16 of which he has been granted bail.

5. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Rajendra Prasad Mishra, has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 02.08.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9677 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9677 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has already been granted bail in 16 other cases of similar nature and that a co-accused has been granted bail, coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 01.07.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case also.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
